description.zh: 自动快照策略的ID。您可以调用[DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyEx](~~25530~~)查看您可用的自动快照策略。
description.en: The ID of the automatic snapshot policy. You can call the [DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicyEx](~~25530~~) operation to query the IDs of available automatic snapshot policies.

description.zh: 自动快照所属的地域ID。您可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~25609~~)查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
description.en: The ID of the region to which the automatic snapshot policy belongs. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~25609~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun ecs delete-auto-snapshot-policy --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --auto-snapshot-policy-id sp-bp14yziiuvu3s6jn0000 --region cn-hangzhou
